about_the_game:
“Cloe, my dear, I hear them—the whispers in the wind, rustling through the branches, murmuring from the roots. The Valley is speaking. Something is shifting, unseen yet present.”

Welcome to Alderwick Valley, a land where the old magic of nature pulses beneath the earth, and every corner holds a secret waiting to be uncovered. 

After being gifted a hut from your Aunt you will then be tasked in providing aid to a nearby village. Craft candles, explore the forest and encounter strange wildlife along the way!

Roam the Valley and discover a wide variety of plants, each with its own unique features and magical properties. 

Some thrive in the warmth of the sun, while others prefer the cool shade of the forest. Others are said to be touched by the ghosts that used to haunt the Valley, and others are filled with different flavored jelly that taste like candy!

As you gather them, carefully document their distinct traits in your Grimoire. Whether they heal, enhance, or transform, each plant offers a special ingredient for your craft. 

The more you learn about them, the more powerful your creations become!

Keep a close eye on the letters you receive from the villagers—each one holds a unique request that reflects their individual needs and troubles. 

A local farmer might need your help to calm the restless pigs on his farm, while the blacksmith could be searching for a candle to reignite his forge. Perhaps the Innkeeper is struggling with a stubborn mold problem that threatens to shut down her business unless you can solve it. 

Each villager's request is unique, and it's up to you to craft the perfect candle to solve their problems.

With the information stored in your Grimoire, you’ll be armed with the knowledge on how to craft magical candles, each designed to address their specific needs.

Explore every inch of Alderwick Valley, where every path, shadow, and glimmer of light promises something unexpected.

Follow winding trails through towering, whispering trees, where the sunlight filters in like magic. Feel the mist on your skin as you approach roaring waterfalls and stand in awe at the stone structure of the caves. 

Crawl through ancient cave systems that pulse with long-forgotten energy, each one holding secrets waiting for the right witch to unlock them.

As you roam freely across the Valley’s breathtaking landscape, you'll stumble upon curious wildlife that may guide or test you, and mysterious relics of an ancient world slowly revealing themselves. 

From moss-covered ruins to enchanted glades, each landmark tells a story—if you’re willing to listen. The Valley is alive, ever-changing, and full of surprises. Let your imagination lead the way—you never know what magic might find you next.

Keep a watchful eye for what the locals call The Moss—a glowing, ancient presence woven deep into the roots of the Valley.

It’s said to hold the last remnants of a forgotten race, its vibrant shimmer once pulsing with life and memory. The Moss isn’t just part of the land—it’s the heartbeat of it, connecting every tree, stone, and whisper in the wind.

So why is it fading away?

🔑 Key Features 🔑

  • 🕯️ Candle Crafting – Collect ingredients and craft magical candles with unique effects

  • 🌲 First-Person Exploration – Wander through a richly detailed, peaceful forest

  • 🧺 Cozy and Relaxing Gameplay – No combat, no pressure — just calm, creative play

  • 🧙 Play as a Witch – Learn forgotten rituals, explore magical traditions, and grow your skills

  • 🧩 Environmental Interactions – Use crafted candles to unlock secrets and shape your surroundings

  • 🧭 Narrative Through Discovery – Uncover the story through exploration, not exposition

short_description: Witchlight invites you into the world of Alderwick Valley. Craft candles to aid villagers, harvest ingredients and discover what secrets the Valley holds. Witch Light invites you to slow down and find meaning in the little things—because even the smallest light can change everything.
